name: Oasis Reach
description: Inter-bot mail (CLAW-076). Provides the reach_send / reach_inbox / reach_read agent tools and injects an unread-count supplement into the agent memory prompt (via registerMemoryPromptSupplement, non-exclusive). Transport is a per-bot /reach/mail/outbox (rw) + /reach/mail/inbox (ro); a host-side relay moves outbox to recipient inboxes and owns all comms policy (routes, rate limits, size caps). Message bodies are delivered to the model nonce-delimited and tagged UNTRUSTED — a peer message may request work but never authorizes a privileged action.

configSchema.description: Must mirror the zod configSchema in index.ts field-for-field (same property names, same optionality). openclaw validates plugin config against THIS static schema at boot, not against index.ts's zod schema — a field present in one but not the other breaks boot for every bot that sets it.

enabled.description: Per-bot rollout gate. The plugin installs fleet-wide; only bots that mount /reach/mail should set this true. Default false.

mailDir.description: Container mail root holding outbox/ (rw) and inbox/ (ro). Default: /reach/mail

statePath.description: Container-writable path for the read cursor (must NOT be under the RO inbox). Default: $HOME/.openclaw/reach-read.json

knownPeers.description: Informational hint of peer bot keys this bot may message (the host relay is the real gate). Shown in the reach_send tool description.
